ai_review.summary: A decent‑sounding recording of a vibe‑filled ’87 show, but both the performance and audio could be sharper.
ai_review.review: The reviewer finds the concert enjoyable for its atmosphere more than its musical execution, noting that fans of the 1987 era will appreciate it. The recording is considered the best available source for this elusive show, yet it still falls short of perfection, earning a modest three‑star rating.
